Prompted I accidentally pushed AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE to a public repo, what should I do?

safeHtmlItem.html: Rotate that access key in the AWS console right away, then scrub it from your git history with a tool like git filter-repo. Treat it as compromised.

title: Prompted Find a good ramen place near me for dinner tonight.

safeHtmlItem.html: I can't see your location, but searching "ramen near me" in Maps will surface the closest highly-rated spots.

title: Prompted Explain how a hash map handles collisions.

safeHtmlItem.html: Most hash maps resolve collisions by chaining — each bucket holds a small list — or by open addressing, where a colliding key probes for the next free slot.
